title_en: Last Night My Sweetheart Passed By
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear (the language is more modern than a typical folk song, but no author can be named). The speaker's gender is ambiguous in places, so my reading treats the speaker as the one departing, and the first stanza is partly guessed.

lines.en: Last night my sweetheart passed by
she said a couple of words to me
I am parting from you, sweetheart.
